import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, leaves_list, dendrogram
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
x=pd.read_csv('disease.samples.q1.tsv',sep='\\t',index_col=0).values
ids=[f'Sample_{i}' for i in range(1,10)]
for name,a in [('log1p',np.log1p(x)),('log2',np.log2(x+0.1))]:
 print('\\n',name)
 cor=np.corrcoef(a.T)
 print('corr')
 print(pd.DataFrame(cor,index=ids,columns=ids).round(4).to_string())
 d=squareform(pdist(a.T,metric='correlation'))
 print('corrdist')
 print(pd.DataFrame(d,index=ids,columns=ids).round(4).to_string())
 z=PCA().fit_transform(StandardScaler().fit_transform(a))
 p=PCA().fit(StandardScaler().fit_transform(a))
 print('PCA var',p.explained_variance_ratio_[:5].round(4))
 print(pd.DataFrame(z[:,:3],index=ids,columns=['PC1','PC2','PC3']).round(3).to_string())
 print('linkage avg order', [ids[i] for i in leaves_list(linkage(pdist(a.T,metric='correlation'),method='average'))])
 print('linkage ward order', [ids[i] for i in leaves_list(linkage(a.T,method='ward'))])
PY"

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
x=pd.read_csv('disease.samples.q1.tsv',sep='\\t',index_col=0)
A=['Sample_1','Sample_4','Sample_6','Sample_8','Sample_9']
B=['Sample_2','Sample_3','Sample_5','Sample_7']
y=np.log2(x+1)
ma=y[A].mean(axis=1); mb=y[B].mean(axis=1)
lfc=ma-mb
res=pd.DataFrame({'Amean_log2':ma,'Bmean_log2':mb,'log2FC_A-B':lfc,'Amean_TPM':x[A].mean(axis=1),'Bmean_TPM':x[B].mean(axis=1)})
res['p']=ttest_ind(y[A],y[B],axis=1,equal_var=False).pvalue
# rank by effects with expression in either group
for label, sub in [('A_up',res[(res['Amean_log2']>1)|(res['Bmean_log2']>1)].sort_values('log2FC_A-B',ascending=False).head(80)),('B_up',res[(res['Amean_log2']>1)|(res['Bmean_log2']>1)].sort_values('log2FC_A-B').head(80))]:
 print('\\n###',label)
 print(sub.round(3).to_string())
print('\\nTop tstat')
res['t']=lfc/np.sqrt(y[A].var(axis=1,ddof=1)/len(A)+y[B].var(axis=1,ddof=1)/len(B))
print(res.sort_values('t',ascending=False).head(40).round(3).to_string())
print('\\nB t')
print(res.sort_values('t').head(40).round(3).to_string())
PY"
